course.title: TED's secret to great public speaking
course.course_title: Great Talks: Building an Idea in Someone Else's Mind
course.audience: someone who has to give a talk soon and has no formula

modules.title: The one job of a speaker
modules.subtitle: Why a talk is a transfer of an idea, and four rules for making it work.

lessons.title: A talk is a gift of an idea
objectives: Explain why there is no single formula for a great talk
Describe the speaker's number one task as transferring an idea into listeners' minds

lessons.title: Why ideas matter
objectives: Explain what a 'worldview' is and how an idea changes how you react
Compare an idea with a fact or a story in terms of what the listener keeps

lessons.title: Four guidelines
objectives: List the four guidelines and apply each to a draft talk
Apply the 'limit your focus' rule by cutting a talk down to one idea
